programs.name: Computer Science BSc (Hons)
programs.a_level_offer: AAA including Maths or AAB including Maths and Computer Science
programs.ib_offer: 37 (6,6,6 HL) including HL Maths or 35 (6,6,5) including HL Maths and Computer Science
programs.ap_offer: Loughborough's United States entry section on the same course page: typical offers are based on a 3.2/4.0 GPA in the High School Graduation Diploma plus a combination of any three of: AP exam, IB Higher Levels, college-level class credit (normally Grade 12, one semester, 3 credits), or Honors classes (a full year in Grade 11 or 12). Grade equivalence: A* = AP 5 (Honors A+); A = AP 5 (Honors A / A-); B = AP 4 (Honors B+ / B); C = AP 3 (Honors B-). Any A-level subject requirement must be met in the relevant AP exam or IB Higher Level; AP Calculus BC is required where AP is used for A-level Maths. For programmes needing GCSE Maths: SAT I Math 570 or higher, or ACT minimum 27 overall and 26 in each component.
programs.required_subjects: Maths (A level, or IB HL / AP Calculus BC); GCSE English Language grade 4/C
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT: tests taken before 21 Jan 2026 (0-120 scale) 88 overall with at least 21 in each test; tests from 21 Jan 2026 (1-6 scale) 4.5 overall with at least 4.5 in Writing and Listening and at least 4.0 in Speaking and Reading.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each element (university standard). PTE Academic 65 (minimum 61 in each sub-test). Duolingo English Test 120 (Speaking 110, Writing 115, Reading 110, Listening 105).
programs.notes: Also offered as a 4-year course with placement year (UCAS G401). September 2027 start; fee is for 2027-28. Access Loughborough contextual offers exist. AP route: the United States section of the course page. English scores: https://www.lboro.ac.uk/study/apply/english-language-requirements/ . International fee is the page's 'Fees for 2027-28 (per academic year)' figure.
